'''2007 Texas State Championship Joseph Graham DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Ol' Big Blue Derdram
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
